localised_description: Ushoran's legacy is in safe hands.
The savage beast knows only rage and fury.
Feed on the rotting flesh of the buried dead and grow strong.
Some races don't take annihilation lying down, and may take centuries to avenge the slight.
Vorag Bloodytooth swore to rebuild Strigos and avenge himself on its destroyers.
Brought back from death to guard their Unliving masters.
The dark secrets of Necromantic lore can be found in the cursed scrolls hidden within the lairs of the oldest Vampire Lords of the Necrarch family.
"Who's queen? That's right… Now, prostrate yourself before me, worm!"
"Give them a taste of what awaits! And do treat yourself to a taste, too."
These deceptive creatures look so inoffensive and vulnerable that the enemy lowers his own defence, which is when they strike…
The Undead display the best type of loyalty, which endures unendingly and without question.
